subject.title: [Feature] Control UI: Support channel-based session view toggle

question: Should the remaining Control UI channel work stop at the newly merged Group by channel table, or should OpenClaw add a first-class separated/merged channel timeline view?
rationale: Current main partially satisfies channel scanning, but a merged timeline needs UX, privacy, transcript aggregation, and Gateway routing semantics that automation cannot infer safely.

options.title: Keep As Scoped Follow-Up
options.body: Keep this issue open and define the separated-view and merged-timeline contract before implementation.

options.title: Treat Grouping As Sufficient
options.body: Close the request as satisfied by current table grouping and explicitly defer merged timelines as out of scope.

options.title: Fold Into Sessions Workspace
options.body: Move the remaining timeline and peek semantics to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/80901 and close this after preserving channel-specific constraints there.

recommendation.title: Keep As Scoped Follow-Up
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and define the separated-view and merged-timeline contract before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current partial channel grouping implementation and are the clearest owner for deciding whether to extend it or stop there.
